notes: PLEA is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 PLEA once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no administrative privileges, transfer fees, or subsequent minting. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
